jobs.description:
About This Role

With over 300 planners across the UK, we are the largest planning department in any mainstream real estate practice with a reputation for success and professionalism.

We work with all types of property, but have specialisms in urban mixed use, housing, retail, major sports venues, energy, master planning, urban design, environmental impact assessment, community engagement, heritage and Section 106 agreements/Community Infrastructure Levy.

We negotiate planning permissions for everything from major urban regeneration schemes to modest domestic extensions. Our department consists of planners skilled in assembling evidence and building a case to achieve planning permission from local authorities, planning inspectors and government ministers.

Planning role locations:

London - Head Office (Margaret Street)

Edinburgh
, Reading
, Bristol
, Birmingham
, Oxford
, Southampton
, Newcastle
, Cardiff
, Glasgow

The Southampton
Planning Team is a Centre of Excellence for Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) in Savills. As a graduate in the team you have the opportunity to be involved in a wide variety of high profile and strategic EIA projects including Residential, Commercial and Mixed-Use developments in urban and non-urban environments. Working alongside our EIA specialists you would gain experience of applying the EIA Regulations to support major planning applications with clear and objective environmental evidence beginning with EIA Screening into Environmental Statement preparation leading to application determination and implementation.

The Central Planning team have 25 planners from graduate to director based in Reading
and Oxford
. We work across urban and rural sites across the region and are working on an exciting and wide range of projects from site promotion for 10,000 new homes, educational and high tech / science industry projects, renewable energy and battery storage schemes and applications for new homes on grey belt land. We are looking for someone who is proactive, driven and who wants to work for the top planning consultancy in the Country on a wide range of high profile projects in a stimulating environment, but also have fun and contribute to the vibrant team dynamic.

The Newcastle
Planning team has rapidly grown to 9 planners, making us one of the largest teams in the region. We are commercially focused, working across a range of land-use sectors including housing, urban and mixed-use, industrial, rural and energy and infrastructure, and sit within the biggest planning consultancy within the UK. Successful graduates will experience hands-on working on some of the North East’s most high-profile projects for a wide variety of clients in a diverse office environment.

As a planning Graduate you will be expected to prepare planning appraisals, undertake research and analysis, prepare planning applications, contribute to the preparation/editing of Design and Access Statements, Sustainability Statements and other planning documents. There will be a variety of exciting projects to work on, helping develop your knowledge and skills. Your input is an essential part of our working processes.

How You’ll Make An Impact

× High attention to detail, well organised and a proactive approach

× Ability to empower those around them

× Strong verbal, numerical and report writing skills

× A team player with leadership potential

× Ability to Listen to others and Collaborate effectively

× Strategic approach to problem solving

Training

Job Description:

Supply Chain Planning Analyst - Broadcom/Fort Collins, Colorado

Broadcom Inc. is a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. Broadcom’s category-leading product portfolio serves critical markets including data center, networking, software, broadband, wireless, storage and industrial. Our solutions include data center networking and storage, enterprise and mainframe software focused on automation, monitoring and security, smartphone components, telecoms and factory automation.

Job Description

Supply Chain Planning Analyst

Broadcom’s Fort Collins Colorado (FTC) semiconductor operation is looking for the right person to join our Factory Business Control team in the role of a Supply Chain Planner. This on site position is an integral support function within the Wireless Semiconductor Division’s (WSD) planning efforts supporting NPI, Production and various engineering efforts targeted to win and maintain business.

Broadcom is a global provider of an extensive range of analog, mixed-signal and optoelectronic components and subsystems to more than 40,000 end customers, including many of the world’s top original equipment manufacturers. The Fort Collins site is Broadcom’s largest semiconductor fabrication facility and delivers RF filters, power amplifiers and front-end module semiconductor solutions to the wireless communications industry.

Fort Collins Colorado and surrounding communities continue to be recognized nationally as among the best places to live. Broadcom offers a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Nature Of Duties/Responsibilities

Act as the point of contact and primary resolution for any Oracle ERP issues or improvements to provide correct and efficient financial costing of products produced within the WSD FTC Mfg. site.
Maintains Oracle ERP Internal Requisitions and Internal Sales Orders to ensure effective, uninterrupted shipment of production material from the FTC WSD Mfg. facilities to approved Contract Manufacturers.
Monitors and executes Lid Lot starts to ensure the consistent and timely flow of manufacturing lots.
Perform quarterly E&O activities to include reporting of E&O material within the WSD Fort Collins site.
Reviews the monthly WSD Production Forecast for data accuracy and validity.
Works both cross functionally and cross geographically to support and implement Planning initiatives to drive improvements and efficiency.
Provides back-up support to other members of the FBC Team, specifically NPI and Production planning activities.
Maintains several FTC Internal business systems in support of NPI, Engineering, and Production.
Generates daily/weekly/monthly reports to communicate Wafer Fab KPI’s to various stakeholders.
Leads and/or attends various meetings as needed to support site initiatives within and outside of FBC objectives
Leads and/or participates in various improvement projects related to FBC group and WSD Manufacturing.
Additional responsibilities as assigned by management team.

Successful candidates will have a stable work history of sustained analytics, planning proficiency, teamwork, and professional growth.

Job Requirement:

8+ years of production planning & and/or related experience
Possess a working knowledge of manufacturing principles, particularly in the semiconductor industry
Bachelor’s degree required, Business or Industrial Engineering preferred.
Strong Knowledge, understanding and practice of MRP principles.
Excellent teamwork, communication, problem solving, customer service, and influencing skills.
Advanced level of experience in Excel.

Preferred Skills:

Oracle ERP Experience
Excel - VBA
Report Building capability (i.e. Spotfire, .NET, Hyperion, )
Industrial Engineering Background
Business process analysis, lean manufacturing, quality management, and software requirements definition

The annual base salary range for this position is $88,300 - $141,300

This position is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus in accordance with relevant plan documents, and equity in accordance with equity plan documents and equity award agreements.

Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. jobs.description:
Salary Range:

About SMU

Salary commensurate with experience and qualifications

SMU’s more than 12,000 diverse, high-achieving students come from all 50 states and over 80 countries to take advantage of the University’s small classes, meaningful research opportunities, leadership development, community service, international study and innovative programs.

SMU serves approximately 7,000 undergraduates and 5,000 graduate students through eight degree-granting schools: Dedman College of Humanities and Sciences, Cox School of Business, Lyle School of Engineering, Meadows School of the Arts, Simmons School of Education and Human Development, Dedman School of Law, Perkins School of Theology and Moody School of Graduate and Advanced Studies.

SMU is data driven, and its powerful supercomputing ecosystem – paired with entrepreneurial drive – creates an unrivaled environment for the University to deliver research excellence.

Now in its second century of achievement, SMU is recognized for the ways it supports students, faculty and alumni as they become ethical, enterprising leaders in their professions and communities. SMU’s relationship with Dallas – the dynamic center of one of the nation’s fastest-growing regions – offers unique learning, research, social and career opportunities that provide a launch pad for global impact.

SMU is nonsectarian in its teaching and committed to academic freedom and open inquiry.

About the Department:

The Office of Finance and Planning (OFP) supports the University's mission by safeguarding assets, maintaining fiscal integrity, and encouraging the rational and effective allocation of the University’s financial resources

About the Position:

This role is an on-campus, in-person position.

The Unit Financial Planning Officer (FPO) provides high-level financial, administrative, and strategic planning support to the unit executive leader to position the Unit meet key performance metrics and strategic goals.

The role analyzes complex data sets and helps the executive leader to understand the data and make data-informed decisions that align with the unit’s strategic plan and optimally contributes to University’s overall strategic plan. Provides oversight of financial planning, resource allocation, business operations, and budget forecasting for the unit and its underlying departments.

The position also works with the University Planning team to develop advanced business and financial models, data analyses, and process improvements in support of unit’s goals and growth.

The FPO provides leadership to the unit and department staff related to the college business functions.

Job level and compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

Essential Functions:

Work with complex data sets, analytics tools, and visualization software to analyze data and help the executive leader to understand the data and make data-informed decisions that align with the unit’s strategic plan and key performance metrics. This includes leading the unit to understand the revenue and cost margins of each department, program, course, and activity, and identifying opportunities for strategic optimization of resources.
Work closely with the Unit executive leader and provides oversight to the departments on financial planning, resource allocation, grants and contracts, business operations, enrollment management, endowments and gifts, scholarships, waivers, GTA / GRA appointments, salary, and benefit allocations, compliance reporting, ranking surveys, budget forecasting, and data needs.
Develop advanced business and financial models for enrollment and revenue projections, evaluate academic programs and new revenue-generating opportunities, models research productivity, workforce planning, faculty hiring, infrastructure assessments, and space needs, and strategically plans for rapidly evolving opportunities and challenges for the unit and its departments.
Work with databases and create new reports as needed.
Understand the financial condition of the unit and its departments, as well as the university, and formulate financially sustainable strategies and contingencies for the unit.
Continuously assesses and monitors financial performance and forecasts budget to actuals.
Represent the unit in business and financial meetings and on University committees.
Serve as a liaison between the unit and the Strategic Financial Planning department of the Office of Finance & Planning and that keeps that office informed of challenges and opportunities.
Collaborate with the directors of the unit team to strengthen and improve business processes within the units, incorporating and sharing university best practices.
Communicates and provides consultative training and guidance to the department chairs and business and administrative staff to ensure they understand the finances of the department and use consistent and effective business practices within the college.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Degree in in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, IT, or a business-related field with emphasis placed on accounting or finance education backgrounds.

A minimum of five years of progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis roles, preferably with some experience in a higher education setting.

Financial consultative experience to either client principals or executive leadership within an organization preferred. Experience analyzing complex data sets and creating graphs and visual formats that allow the unit executive leader and administrators to quickly understand the analysis desired. Experience creating financial models, using databases and AI, and in creating informative reports and dashboards to inform decision-making is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Candidate must demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate broadly across the University and serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on financial, operational, and strategic matters. Must also demonstrate strong written communication skills. Skill in presenting complex financial and operational information into actionable recommendations for executive leadership and influence decision-making to positive outcomes is essential.

Candidate must possess strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and analyze problems, as well as devise solutions. Must also have the ability to align resource planning and financial strategies with institutional and unit priorities. The ability to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and optimization of resources is essential.

Candidate must have strong organizational, planning and time-management skills. A keen attention to detail and accuracy is essential.

Candidate must have skill in developing dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations that simplify complex information required. Must also have an intermediate to advanced level with Microsoft Excel. Data analysis and integrity skills and ability to conjoin data from multiple systems is essential.

Experience with ERP systems, FP&A systems and reporting tools strongly preferred. Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics and visualization platforms desired.

Physical and Environmental Demands:

Sit for long periods of time

Deadline to Apply:

The position is open until filled.

EEO Statement

SMU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, or gender identity and expression.

Benefits:

SMU offers staff a broad, competitive array of health and related benefits. In addition to traditional benefits such as health, dental, and vision plans, SMU offers a wide range of wellness programs to help attract, support, and retain our employees whose work continues to make SMU an outstanding education and research institution.

SMU is committed to providing an array of retirement programs that benefit and protect you and your family throughout your working years at SMU and, if you meet SMU's retirement eligibility criteria, during your retirement years after you leave SMU.

The value of learning at SMU isn't just about preparing our students for the future. Employees have access to a wide variety of professional and personal development opportunities, including tuition benefits.

jobs.description:
Description

The Strategic Account Services (SAS) organization is seeking Customer Success Managers to shape the future of the program and drive business growth for some of the most influential Sellers and Brands on the Amazon Store. CSMs ensure program satisfaction by delivering an optimal level of service through strategic insights and relentlessly high operational standards.

In this role, you will own building and executing strategic joint business plans with your Sellers, collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, traffic and conversion drivers, and operational improvement opportunities. You will also develop and manage a pipeline mix of both high-value and transactional accounts while executing sales and account management strategies to deliver results that exceed output goals. This includes identifying and building relationships with key influencers and decision-makers within the senior management and executive teams of prospective and existing accounts, along with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams, to create and present compelling Amazon solutions that meet and exceed customer requirements.

The ideal candidate should possess client management skills with the keen ability to work backwards with Sellers to identify and prioritize the right inputs and outputs to deliver value and growth. They will be able to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced work environment and actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives to multiply impact beyond their portfolios. Above all, they should demonstrate ownership and the ability to embrace and navigate ambiguity and complexity. They are agile, inventive, and an advocate for their Sellers' experience on the Amazon Store.

Key job responsibilities

Customer Success Managers are responsible for driving Seller business growth by providing customized insights and recommendations, educating on relevant tools, products, and services, and delivering a positive experience with the program. This includes analyzing data and trends to maximize long-term potential for an assigned portfolio of Sellers, leading business strategy development and long-term account planning, and acting as a strategic and consultative partner who proactively identifies new opportunities and presents compelling value propositions. CSMs manage and deliver against complex account goals — often where strategy is not yet defined — making tradeoffs between short-term customer needs and longer-term strategic investment while implementing and tracking metrics to uncover hidden areas of opportunity.

CSMs also serve as trusted advisors and business advocates for their Sellers, delivering timely operational support within specified SLAs and coordinating cross-functionally to resolve issues quickly and with high quality. They play a "consultant" role with oversight of key strategic activities, escalating and clearing blockers across multiple organizations while advocating as the Voice of the Customer internally. On the process excellence side, CSMs act as thought leaders in defining success criteria, improve team efficiency by optimizing processes and delivering critical solutions, and identify feature enhancements and new products based on customer feedback, data analysis, and competitive gaps. They own project status communication and aggregate themes to address root-cause opportunities with owning teams.

A day in the life

Customer Success Managers balance their day across three core activities:

Outbound prospecting: Conducting calls and email outreach to prospective Sellers to identify growth and optimization opportunities
Active account management: Communicating with engaged Sellers to execute against joint business plans, review performance metrics, educate on new tools and programs, and drive progress on strategic initiatives
Internal deep dives: Collaborating cross-functionally to resolve Seller friction points, clear blockers, analyze data trends, and advocate for Seller needs with internal partner teams

CSMs work autonomously while earning the trust of their peers and Sellers. They are highly motivated, results-driven, and operate with a consultative mindset — whether managing long-term strategic accounts or time-bound engagements focused on specific optimization goals like FBA supply chain improvement.

About The Team

CSMs in Strategic Account Services operate within category-specific portfolios (e.g., Health & Personal Care), managing high-value, long-term Seller relationships with a focus on strategic growth, program satisfaction, and driving business results for some of Amazon's most influential Brands and Sellers. The team's mission is driving Seller success on the Amazon Store through data-driven insights, consultative partnership, and relentless operational excellence.

Basic Qualifications

Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience analysing market opportunities, engaging and negotiating with customers, and defining new areas of innovation
Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
Experience using analysis, reporting, modeling, and forecasting to gather data for the purpose of making business decisions
Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
Experience building customer relationships, identifying business opportunities for clients and increasing adoption and utilization of company products
4+ years professional experience in Buying, Merchandising, Planning and/or relevant experience within Customer Success, Account Management, Management Consulting and/or relevant experience in negotiating, nurturing, and growing customer relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in Sales, Territory Planning, Merchandising, and/or relevant experience within Customer Success, Account Management, or negotiating, nurturing, and growing customer relationships
Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives
Experience using analytical, account management, and productivity tools, such as, Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Tableau, or similar

The Manager of Customer Success- AI, acts as the subject matter expert and operational guide for Weave’s cutting-edge AI product suite, including our flagship AI Receptionist, and TrueLark legacy product. This individual manages and mentors a dedicated team of Weave across various designations- all firmly rooted in AI success- while maintaining strategic, hands-on ownership of a select portfolio of high-value, complex accounts. Your mission is to maximize product utilization, optimize conversational AI configurations to eliminate caller friction, and craft compelling data-driven ROI stories that secure long-term customer retention. Serving as a hybrid mentor and strategic consultant, you will bridge the gap between technical AI performance and executive-level business outcomes.

Reports to: Director of Enterprise Customer Success
This role is Hybrid

What You Will Own

Team Leadership & Mentorship (Coach Scope):
Mentor, coach, and guide a team of Customer Success professionals, fostering a deep operational understanding of AI optimization methodologies and data translation.
Drive team-wide performance around core retention, feature adoption, and AI utilization metrics.
Conduct regular coaching, play review, and skill development sessions to build a team of highly consultative AI advocates.

Strategic Portfolio Ownership (Player Scope):
Directly manage a high-impact, strategic book of business of Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts.
Partner with key client decision-makers to align Weave’s AI solutions with their complex operational workflows and growth objectives.

AI Workflow Optimization:
Deeply analyze client operations, call coverage routing, scheduling patterns, and AI configuration to remove customer friction and maximize receptionist utilization.
Drive high-impact optimization playbooks to improve AI handle rates and operational efficiency for multi-location practices.

Data-Driven ROI Storytelling & Retention:
Interpret complex usage dashboards, call handle metrics, and commercial value data to build robust ROI business cases for customers.
Craft compelling, executive-ready presentations and QBRs that demonstrate concrete cost-savings and revenue expansion driven by AI features.
Systematically identify customer health risks and operationalize repeatable playbooks to mitigate churn and drive net retention.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Serve as the critical feedback loop between the front line and the Product, Engineering, Onboarding, and Sales teams to influence the AI product roadmap and refine the implementation process.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
AI Utilization & Handle Rates: Drive high feature adoption and call handle rates across both individual and team-managed portfolios.
Net Revenue Retention (NRR): Achieve target logo and net retention, minimizing preventable churn by proving the economic value of Weave's AI offering.
ROI Program Execution: Standardize the delivery of data-driven business reviews showing verifiable customer ROI across the team.

What You Will Need To Accomplish The Job

SaaS CS & Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or consultative client-facing roles, with a proven track record of mentoring, leading projects, or coaching team members in a SaaS environment.
AI & Workflow Configuration Expertise: Strong technical and consultative aptitude with hands-on experience configuring telephony, call routing, conversational AI, or complex scheduling workflows.
Data Literacy & ROI Storytelling: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to interpret raw usage data, translate technical metrics (e.g., call answer rates, automated handle times) into financial ROI, and present them convincingly to senior executives.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: Experience managing and advising complex multi-location accounts, establishing trust as a consultative business partner.
Communication Excellence: Elite verbal and written communication skills and the ability to be effective in both internal and external communication.

What Will Make Us Love You

You are deeply passionate about artificial intelligence, emerging SaaS trends, and finding creative ways to automate client operations.
You possess a strong builder mindset—you enjoy creating playbooks, frameworks, and tools from scratch to help your team scale.
You are an empathetic leader and culture-builder who inspires others and brings a supportive, positive energy to the workplace.
You navigate growth-stage ambiguity with ease, adopting extreme ownership of obstacles and transforming them into strategic opportunities.

new_jobs.description:
Globality is the autonomous sourcing platform to manage the entire intake to award process.

At Globality, we build agentic technology that transforms how global enterprises source goods and services — autonomously, at scale, and without the inefficiencies that have defined procurement for decades. Our platform interprets purchase intent, generates sourcing materials, evaluates suppliers, and executes negotiation strategies without manual intervention.

The Role

Globality is looking for a Sr. Associate, Customer Success to help manage our enterprise client relationships (typically Fortune 500/Global 2000 corporations) across the full customer lifecycle — from implementation through expansion. The successful applicant will drive clients' adoption of Globality, identify and grow new use cases within existing accounts, and ensure continued satisfaction and measurable value realization. You will be part of the Customer Success team, managing multiple client accounts at any given time. We are looking for a business development-oriented professional who values customer engagement, has a passion for digital transformation, and can build strong customer relationships — someone who can grow with the role as Customer Success evolves.

What You Will Do

Support clients through early stages of the implementation cycle through to enterprise-wide adoption, including providing client trainings, close cooperation throughout adoption, proactive identification and mitigation of possible challenges to adoption, and issue escalations.
Identify key customer stakeholders and develop strategies to build deep trusted advisor relationships, communicating the value of Globality's platform.
Understand complex client requirements, proactively and creatively problem solve utilizing existing product functionality. Where appropriate, liaise with product and engineering teams to implement those.
Drive adoption of additional use cases within existing accounts, identifying whitespace where Globality can deliver further value.
Play a pivotal role in account expansion, partnering closely with sales and partner teams to identify, scope, and close growth opportunities within your client portfolio.
Collaborate with sales, partner, and marketing teams to build and execute account growth strategies, from opportunity identification through renewal and expansion.
Own and report on key account health metrics, including Net Promoter Score (NPS) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR), translating data into actionable insights that improve client outcomes and inform expansion strategy.
Track success criteria and prepare regular reports on account status.
Capture and share best practices both within your client portfolio and across the wider customer success team.

What You Bring

2+ years of experience in consulting, account management, or client-facing roles
Undergraduate degree required (ideally in engineering, economics, supply chain management, procurement, business administration, or similar)
Ability to communicate, present to, and influence key stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Advanced problem-solving skills and verbal and written communication skills
Proven experience juggling multiple tasks at a time while maintaining strong attention to detail
Ability to capture customers' needs pragmatically and match them with appropriate products and services
Comfort operating in a role that spans both implementation and growth responsibilities, with the flexibility to adapt as the Customer Success function evolves
Advanced in Microsoft products, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools preferred
Proficiency in multiple languages is advantageous and highly valued
Procurement and/or technology/AI experience preferred

Why Globality

The opportunity is enormous.
Enterprise procurement is one of the last major business functions to be transformed by AI. We're not optimizing at the margins — we're fundamentally rethinking how trillions of dollars get spent.

The team is world-class.
Our leadership team brings decades of experience from leading global enterprises, and our culture is built for people who want real ownership, not titles.

You'll have real impact.
This isn't a role where you execute someone else's playbook. You'll shape the strategy, build the programs, and see the direct business impact of your work.

We work together — literally.
We're in-office 4 days a week in Palo Alto because the best ideas – and the fastest decisions – happen face to face. One day is yours to work wherever you’re most effective.

Customer Success Manager - Marketplace

Torch Dental | Full-time

About Torch Dental

Torch Dental is a high-growth, venture-backed vertical SaaS company transforming how dental practices run their businesses. Our mission is to give every dental office the modern software, automation, and visibility they need to operate efficiently and profitably.

About the Role

Customer Success Manager
is a foundational role focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience and driving value across a book of small to mid-sized accounts. You’ll guide customers through onboarding, support their early adoption, and proactively work to retain and grow their relationship with Torch.

In this role, you’ll use core skills in customer engagement, platform expertise, and will be heavily focused on retention and renewals. You’ll also play an important role in capturing customer feedback, identifying patterns, and collaborating cross-functionally to improve the overall experience. This is a great opportunity for someone eager to build a career in Customer Success with a fast-growing, customer-obsessed team.

What you’ll do

Customer Relationship Management

Own a portfolio of complex customer accounts from onboarding through early adoption to renewal, ensuring a smooth and supportive experience.
Drive product usage and value through regular check-ins, education, and support touchpoints.
Understand customer goals and challenges and ensure Torch is delivering on their needs.
Track account health, flag potential risks early, and surface retention concerns to the team.
Help customers get the most out of Torch’s features, especially those related to cost savings, time efficiency, and vendor consolidation.
Use data and platform insights to personalize outreach and demonstrate value (savings, time saved, etc.)
Run regular practice reviews with customers for goal alignment and consult on how they can continuously maximize their success on the platform.
Focus on GMV retention, helping ensure that customers continue to consolidate and grow their purchasing on Torch over time.

Internal Collaboration & Process Improvement

Log key customer insights in Salesforce and help identify trends across your book of business.
Provide feedback to the product, supplier, and operations teams based on customer conversations.
Support pilot programs or process experiments in cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering and supplier teams.

What we're looking for

Required:

1-2+ years in a customer success, account management, or sales, ideally in a startup or fast-scaling SaaS environment.
Strong written and verbal communication. You'll be working with dental office staff through onboarding, adoption and long term retention so building trust and establishing yourself as their key source of support is key.
Strong tech competency. You will be working directly with customers on integrating their current ordering processes into our solution and will need to be able to communicate with users who may not be as comfortable with tech-first solutions.
Excellent organizational skills, you will be managing 250-350 accounts in your book of business and need to be able to context switch as you assist both new and well established Torch customers with their every day needs.

new_jobs.description:
Description

The Strategic Account Services (SAS) organization is seeking Customer Success Managers to shape the future of the program and drive business growth for some of the most influential Sellers and Brands on the Amazon Store. CSMs ensure program satisfaction by delivering an optimal level of service through strategic insights and relentlessly high operational standards.

In this role, you will own building and executing strategic joint business plans with your Sellers, collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, traffic and conversion drivers, and operational improvement opportunities. You will also develop and manage a pipeline mix of both high-value and transactional accounts while executing sales and account management strategies to deliver results that exceed output goals. This includes identifying and building relationships with key influencers and decision-makers within the senior management and executive teams of prospective and existing accounts, along with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams, to create and present compelling Amazon solutions that meet and exceed customer requirements.

The ideal candidate should possess client management skills with the keen ability to work backwards with Sellers to identify and prioritize the right inputs and outputs to deliver value and growth. They will be able to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced work environment and actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives to multiply impact beyond their portfolios. Above all, they should demonstrate ownership and the ability to embrace and navigate ambiguity and complexity. They are agile, inventive, and an advocate for their Sellers' experience on the Amazon Store.

Key job responsibilities

Customer Success Managers are responsible for driving Seller business growth by providing customized insights and recommendations, educating on relevant tools, products, and services, and delivering a positive experience with the program. This includes analyzing data and trends to maximize long-term potential for an assigned portfolio of Sellers, leading business strategy development and long-term account planning, and acting as a strategic and consultative partner who proactively identifies new opportunities and presents compelling value propositions. CSMs manage and deliver against complex account goals — often where strategy is not yet defined — making tradeoffs between short-term customer needs and longer-term strategic investment while implementing and tracking metrics to uncover hidden areas of opportunity.

CSMs also serve as trusted advisors and business advocates for their Sellers, delivering timely operational support within specified SLAs and coordinating cross-functionally to resolve issues quickly and with high quality. They play a "consultant" role with oversight of key strategic activities, escalating and clearing blockers across multiple organizations while advocating as the Voice of the Customer internally. On the process excellence side, CSMs act as thought leaders in defining success criteria, improve team efficiency by optimizing processes and delivering critical solutions, and identify feature enhancements and new products based on customer feedback, data analysis, and competitive gaps. They own project status communication and aggregate themes to address root-cause opportunities with owning teams.

A day in the life

Customer Success Managers balance their day across three core activities:

Outbound prospecting: Conducting calls and email outreach to prospective Sellers to identify growth and optimization opportunities
Active account management: Communicating with engaged Sellers to execute against joint business plans, review performance metrics, educate on new tools and programs, and drive progress on strategic initiatives
Internal deep dives: Collaborating cross-functionally to resolve Seller friction points, clear blockers, analyze data trends, and advocate for Seller needs with internal partner teams

CSMs work autonomously while earning the trust of their peers and Sellers. They are highly motivated, results-driven, and operate with a consultative mindset — whether managing long-term strategic accounts or time-bound engagements focused on specific optimization goals like FBA supply chain improvement.

About The Team

CSMs in Strategic Account Services operate within category-specific portfolios (e.g., Health & Personal Care), managing high-value, long-term Seller relationships with a focus on strategic growth, program satisfaction, and driving business results for some of Amazon's most influential Brands and Sellers. The team's mission is driving Seller success on the Amazon Store through data-driven insights, consultative partnership, and relentless operational excellence.

Basic Qualifications

Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience analysing market opportunities, engaging and negotiating with customers, and defining new areas of innovation
Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
Experience using analysis, reporting, modeling, and forecasting to gather data for the purpose of making business decisions
Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
Experience building customer relationships, identifying business opportunities for clients and increasing adoption and utilization of company products
4+ years professional experience in Buying, Merchandising, Planning and/or relevant experience within Customer Success, Account Management, Management Consulting and/or relevant experience in negotiating, nurturing, and growing customer relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in Sales, Territory Planning, Merchandising, and/or relevant experience within Customer Success, Account Management, or negotiating, nurturing, and growing customer relationships
Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives
Experience using analytical, account management, and productivity tools, such as, Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Tableau, or similar
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
Experience in E-Commerce, Corporate Retail, Consulting and/or B2B.
Understanding of retail math and formulas for the purpose of making business decisions.
Leverage internal AI tooling to drive efficiencies and expedite problem solving

Preferred - 3 years of experience in data analytics, trending, forecasting, modeling, and reporting in healthcare.

Advanced computer software knowledge including Microsoft Office - Excel, Word, and Power Point, Tableau and database applications.
Strong competency in Excel, Tableau, or other data analysis; mapping; and/or visualization software.

About Bestow

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov .

About The Team

The Bestow Revenue team is transforming life insurance by giving carriers the technology platform to modernize their products and distribution. Our end-to-end enterprise SaaS platform lets carriers launch fully customized life insurance products in months, give customers and advisors a modern experience, and grow through continuous testing and iteration. That end-to-end approach is genuinely rare in insurance technology, and it means our customers avoid costly point-solution integrations.

This role reports to Bestow's Director of Customer Success and is open to Remote (US)

What You'll Do

The Customer Success Manager owns the relationship, health, and growth of Bestow's enterprise carrier customers. You are the customer's primary point of contact at Bestow, and the person internal teams look to for a clear read on what the customer needs and why it matters. You will run your accounts end to end: performance, escalations, roadmap alignment, and the executive relationships that keep the business moving.

Own the day-to-day and executive relationship for a portfolio of enterprise carrier customers, serving as their primary point of contact at Bestow.
Run the operating rhythm for your accounts: recurring business reviews, performance reporting against service level objectives (SLOs), and quarterly planning with customer leadership.
Build and deliver executive-level business reviews that connect platform performance to the customer's commercial goals.
Own escalations end to end, from first signal through resolution and customer follow-up, coordinating Engineering, Product, and Implementation as needed.
Translate customer needs into prioritized work with Product and Engineering, and make the case with data when something deserves to move up the roadmap.
Identify expansion and adoption opportunities inside your accounts, and work with Sales on the path to close.
Own due diligence, compliance documentation, and audit responses for your customers, organizing subject-matter experts and holding deadlines.
Mentor Customer Success Associates and raise the bar on how the team documents, reports, and communicates.
Travel as needed for solution workshops, leadership onsites, and customer business reviews.

Who You Are

4 or more years in customer success or account management, ideally at a SaaS or technology company serving enterprise customers.
You have owned enterprise customer relationships directly, including executive stakeholders, and can point to accounts you grew or turned around.
Energized by complex problems and comfortable being the person accountable for the answer.
Fluent working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Sales, and effective without formal authority.
Skilled at building and delivering polished, client-facing presentations for executive audiences.
Strong analytical instincts. You work with data directly and use it to make a case, not just to report.
Clear, direct communicator in writing and in the room, with real attention to detail.
Experience with CRM and ticketing tools such as Salesforce and JIRA.
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits include:

Competitive salary and equity based on role
Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs
100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance
Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing
Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote
Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting
Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
